diagnostics.relative_l2_denominator: L2 norm of the concatenated reference arrays for each comparison category; per-leaf denominator is the leaf L2 norm. A zero denominator yields 0 when the difference norm is also zero and infinity otherwise.

memory.aggregate_policy: sum of simultaneous per-rank samples at the same sample timestamp; never the sum of independent rank maxima
memory.criterion: The preflight OD-8 gate still uses the whole-process sampled peak at or below 80% of the device total. Campaign rows report training-window and whole-process sampled peaks without adding a new acceptance threshold.
qualifications: Reported peaks are sampled nvidia-smi per-process used-memory values at a 0.25 s target interval, not continuous high-water marks.
GPU process usage includes framework allocator caches and runtime/communication overhead; it is not a pure tensor footprint.
Training-window peaks use per-rank wall-clock windows recorded at the synchronized start and end of the measured updates; warmup, reset, final hashing, snapshots, and teardown are outside the window.

Campaign coverage requires at least max(2, ceil(window_seconds)) training samples per rank inside its training window, plus simultaneous samples spanning the common window within a 5.0 s slack and no simultaneous gap over 5.0 s; the short preflight requires one training-window sample per rank after whole-process coverage. A trace that stops early is rejected.
Sample timestamps must be strictly increasing. Duplicate or out-of-order TIME blocks are rejected, and only distinct instants contribute to sample density.
Startup peaks and whole-process peaks are reported separately so initialization is not attributed to training.
Aggregate device footprint sums simultaneous per-rank samples; it is never the sum of independent rank maxima.
Framework allocator counters are supplementary and retain their own semantics; they are not substituted for sampled process usage.
